findings.evidence:
`pkg/planner/core/explain.go:836` `PhysicalWindow.ExplainInfo()` calls `formatWindowFuncDescs(...)`; `pkg/planner/core/explain.go:898-905` hardcodes `desc.StringWithCtx(ctx, perrors.RedactLogDisable)`.
`pkg/expression/aggregation/base_func.go:74-84` stringifies window func args via `arg.StringWithCtx(ctx, redact)`.
`pkg/expression/constant.go:144-160` returns raw constant when `redact==OFF`.
So any window-function literal args (e.g. `lead(col, 2, 'secret')`) will appear unredacted in EXPLAIN even when `tidb_redact_log=ON/MARKER`.
findings.fix: In `formatWindowFuncDescs`, pass the active redact mode instead of `perrors.RedactLogDisable`, e.g. `desc.StringWithCtx(ctx, ctx.GetTiDBRedactLog())` (or `p.SCtx().GetSessionVars().EnableRedactLog` if you prefer session vars). Add redact tests for window funcs with constant args (lead/lag/ntile/nth_value/default).
findings.impact: Sensitive literals inside window function descriptors can leak via `EXPLAIN` output (and any downstream logging that embeds EXPLAIN info, e.g. slow log), undermining the `tidb_redact_log` guarantee.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on later history: `upstream/master` (b75374faa6) and `pingcap/master` (3b531d4e3d) both still have `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_window.go` `FormatWindowFuncDescs` calling `desc.StringWithCtx(ctx, perrors.RedactLogDisable)`.
findings.verify: With `set session tidb_redact_log=ON`, run `EXPLAIN select lead(a, 2, 'secret') over(order by b) from t;` and confirm the window func descriptor shows `?` placeholders for literals; with `MARKER`, confirm literals are wrapped in `‹ ›`.
findings.what: `EXPLAIN` redaction is bypassed for window function descriptors: `PhysicalWindow` formats `WindowFuncDesc` with `RedactLogDisable`, so window-function literal arguments are not redacted when `tidb_redact_log` is enabled.

subject: *: support tidb_redact_log for explain (#54553)
summary: Most EXPLAIN string paths now propagate `tidb_redact_log` via `StringWithCtx(..., redact)`/range redaction, but `PhysicalWindow` still hardcodes `RedactLogDisable` for window function descriptors, leaking window-function literal args under redaction.
